# Solivance Electric LLC

> Licensed Texas commercial and residential electrical contractor based at 13035 S Post Oak Rd Suite I, Houston, TX 77045 (Southwest Houston), serving Meyerland, Bellaire, West University, the Heights, the Memorial Villages and the Greater Houston metro. Panel upgrades, standby generators, parking-lot lighting, soffit lighting, EV chargers, warehouse builds, RV park pedestals, mobile-home connections. 24-hour emergency response.

## Services

- **Panel upgrades** — 200A through 3-phase commercial switchgear. 1–3 days on site after permit + utility coordination. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/services/panel-upgrades
- **Briggs & Stratton generator sales** — Authorized Briggs & Stratton standby generator dealer. PowerProtect (13–26 kW, 7-yr warranty) and Fortress liquid-cooled (30–60 kW), plus B&S and ASCO transfer switches. Listed at MAP pricing; buy unit only or installed. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/generators
- **Financing** — Financing available through Synchrony on generators, panel upgrades, EV chargers, and other electrical work. Ask about monthly payment options. Subject to credit approval. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/financing
- **Houston generator size calculator** — Free tool: answer 2 questions, see which standby generators fit a Houston home, with a size chart and real prices. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/generator-size-calculator
- **Generator installs** — Standby generators with ATS commissioning, concrete pad, fuel line, final inspection. 2–5 working days. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/services/generator-installs
- **Parking lot lighting** — LED retrofits and ground-up lighting to photometric spec. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/services/parking-lot-lighting
- **Soffit lighting** — Architectural LED under the eaves. Recessed 4-inch downlights, continuous ribbon, or RGBW color-changing systems. Damp-rated fixtures, dedicated 20A circuit, photocell and timer. 1–2 days on site. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/services/soffit-lighting
- **EV chargers** — Level 2 and DC fast chargers for office lots, apartment complexes, fleet yards, retail. Load calc + make-ready infrastructure. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/services/ev-chargers
- **Commercial warehouses** — Ground-up electrical for warehouses, distribution, light-industrial. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/services/commercial-warehouses
- **New home builds** — Custom single-family, spec builds, small-to-mid multi-family. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/services/home-builds
- **Commercial & shopping centers** — Retail pads, strip centers, mixed-use, shopping-center developments. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/services/commercial-centers
- **RV park pedestals** — 30A/50A power pedestal arrays for RV parks, marinas, commercial lots. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/services/pedestals
- **Mobile home connections** — Mobile and manufactured-home service connections, meter loops, feeders. https://www.solivanceelectric.com/services/mobile-home-connections

## Quoting

Every job is a fixed-fee quote in writing after a free on-site walk — no ballparks over the phone. Each project is scoped to the building: service size and gear, feeder and trenching distance, fixture or stall count, fuel and pad work where applicable, and utility coordination. Final scope is confirmed against the site (and against the GC drawings on design-build work) before any material is ordered.

## Compliance

- NEC 2023 installation standard on every job
- OSHA 1910.147 lockout/tagout on all energized work
- Harris County, City of Houston, Fort Bend and Montgomery County permits
- CenterPoint Energy cut-over coordination
- All inspections pulled and met by Solivance Electric (customer does not chase the permit office)
